description:
Train a Boosting Classification model using the loaded 'ToothGrowth' dataset. 

1. Open the 'Boosting Classification' analysis from the Machine Learning module.
2. Set 'supp' (Supplement) as the Target variable.
3. Set 'len' (Length) and 'dose' (Dosage) as Predictors.
4. Under Data Split, set the Test set percentage to 30%.
5. Set the Number of trees to 50.
6. Set the Shrinkage to 0.1.
7. Enable 'Confusion matrix' and 'ROC curve' output options.
8. Enable the 'Out-of-bag improvement' plot.
9. Save the analysis as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/BoostingClassification.jasp'.
